One(1) proposal was submitted under Request for Proposal (RFP)#6-20, forthe City of Cheyenne
Public, Educational, and Governmental (PEG) Access Channel Programming Equipment and
Production Equipment Upgrade Project.
The one (1) proposal that was received was submitted by Audiomatrix Inc, Cheyenne, Wyoming.
Audiomatrix Inc was the sole vendor in attendance at the Mandatory Pre-Proposal Meeting.
Upon review and scoring by the evaluation panel composed of four (4) staff members, the panel
has recommended acceptance of the proposal submitted by Audiomatrix Inc, Cheyenne,
Wyoming.The project is tobe awarded in an amount not to exceed$74,537.65.
